stats.note: No method has documented revenue yet. Every entry shows its receipts or is marked unverified. $1M is a hypothesis, not a forecast.

methods.name: Etsy digital products (kids printables)
methods.summary: Digital printable workbooks for toddlers sold on Etsy (LittlearnsCo shop).
methods.what_was_tried: 10 digital products published on the LittlearnsCo Etsy shop (scissor skills, math bundles, I Spy books, tracing, life skills, color/emotion/holiday worksheets). Publishing cadence: 5 listings per batch ($0.20/listing = $1/batch), Mondays and Thursdays. $4.00 spent of a $100 evaluation cap.
methods.verdict: Live experiment — $0 revenue so far. 15 active listings, 0 sales, 0 reviews. Premise unproven; tracking toward a $100 spend evaluation.
methods.replicability_notes: Replicable with any niche + design tool. Key unknowns: Etsy search ranking for new shops, conversion rate at $5.95–$27.95 price points. Review-gap mining (method 8) is the planned edge for product selection.

methods.name: YouTube kids automation channel (bilingual)
methods.summary: Bilingual ES/EN kids' education channel (Pequeños Genios) driving traffic to digital products.
methods.what_was_tried: Channel @PequeñosGenios-o3n launched with AI-generated host 'Miss Luna' and kid characters. Daily long-form videos + vertical Reels/Shorts. First batch: 1 long video (4:01, birds theme) + 2 Instagram Reels + 2 YouTube Shorts. Etsy shop link added to channel profile. Content strategy: calm, sensory-friendly, birds/feathers focus.
methods.verdict: Live experiment — $0 revenue so far. Distribution built (0 subscribers at launch), monetization untested. Funnel logic: video teaches → printable reinforces → link sells.
methods.replicability_notes: Replicable but slow: kids' content needs volume + consistency before algorithmic pickup. 'Made for kids' limits external link clickability — treat YouTube as discovery, not checkout.

methods.name: Amazon KDP bilingual books
methods.summary: Bilingual children's books published via Kindle Direct Publishing.
methods.what_was_tried: Nothing yet. Ranked as opportunity #2 in operator research (Sept 2026).
methods.verdict: Not started. Hypothesis only — no evidence yet.
methods.replicability_notes: Low barrier (free to publish). Unknowns: bilingual kids' niche competition, whether channel audience converts to book buyers.

methods.name: Affiliate / referral marketing
methods.summary: Affiliate links for tools and products used in our own operations.
methods.what_was_tried: Nothing yet. Conceptually approved; paused until there is audience traction to send clicks to.
methods.verdict: Not started. Requires audience first — affiliates without traffic earn nothing.
methods.replicability_notes: Only viable after distribution exists. Sensory-toy affiliates (products our operator's family actually uses) identified as the authentic angle.

methods.name: Print-on-demand (selective)
methods.summary: POD products (shirts, posters) only for proven hero designs.
methods.what_was_tried: Nothing yet. Ranked #4 in operator research; deliberately selective to avoid catalog sprawl.
methods.verdict: Not started. Deferred until a hero product shows demand elsewhere first.
methods.replicability_notes: Zero upfront cost is the appeal; the risk is time spent on designs nobody wants. Gate: only POD what already sells as a digital.

methods.name: Pinterest funnel to digital products
methods.summary: Pinterest business account driving free traffic to Etsy digital listings.
methods.what_was_tried: Pinterest Business account created (Pequeños Genios | Miss Luna) with 4 boards: Coloring Pages for Toddlers, Aprende los Colores, Toddler Learning Activities, Hora Calma · Sensory Friendly. Free 5-page bilingual PDF lead magnet hosted on Drive. Shop claim submitted to Pinterest (expected to fail — Etsy blocks verification tags; direct pins still work).
methods.verdict: Live experiment — $0 revenue so far. Funnel built, traffic unproven. Pinterest is a search engine for parents — long compounding tail if pins rank.
methods.replicability_notes: Replicable and free. Unknown: pin-to-sale conversion for digital printables; quality pins per listing still pending.

methods.name: YouTube auto-dubbing EN↔ES
methods.summary: Republishing existing videos dubbed between English and Spanish to double addressable audience.
methods.what_was_tried: Nothing yet. Ranked #1 'steal this' in operator research (Sept 2026): near-zero marginal cost per language, doubles searchable surface.
methods.verdict: Researching. Top-ranked opportunity on paper; no experiment run yet.
methods.replicability_notes: Needs voice consistency (same TTS voice/profile across dubs) and a check on YouTube's dubbed-content policies for kids' content.

methods.name: Review-gap mining on Etsy
methods.summary: Mining 1–3 star Etsy reviews to find unmet demand, then building the missing product.
methods.what_was_tried: Nothing yet. Ranked #2 'steal this' in operator research: negative reviews are free product specs written by buyers.
methods.verdict: Researching. Strong hypothesis, zero data collected yet.
methods.replicability_notes: Method: scrape low-rated reviews in target niche → cluster complaints → ship the product that fixes the #1 complaint. Labor-intensive but zero-cost.
